description_en: Submits an AI video generation task
description_zh: 提交视频生成任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun yike submit-video-generation-job --client-token 00003e761e9d11edba640c42a1b70000 --job-type text_to_video --model happyhorse-1.1 --scene general --input 'Prompt_:_图1在篮球场上，用图2来了个灌篮_,_Medias_:_Type_:_image_,_Url_:_https://xxx/xxx.jpg_,_Type_:_image_,_Url_:_https://xxx/xxx.jpg' --job-parameters example-string --resolution 720P --aspect-ratio 9:16 --duration 5 --n 1 --user-data env_:_prd --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoGenerationJob

parameters.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

- text_to_video: text-to-video
- image_to_video: image-to-video
- first_last_frame: first and last frame to video
- reference_to_video: reference to video
parameters.description_zh:

- image_to_video ，图生视频
- first_last_frame ，首尾帧生视频
- reference_to_video，参考生视频

parameters.description_en: The scene type. Currently only `general` is supported.

parameters.help_zh: 场景类型，枚举类型，当前仅有 `general`

parameters.description_en:
The task input in JSON string format. The following fields are included:

- Prompt: String. Required. The prompt.
- Medias: The list of media items.
  - When JobType is set to image_to_video, this field is required. Only 1 Media item is needed.
  - When JobType is set to first_last_frame, this field is required. Only 2 Media items are needed.
  - When JobType is set to reference_to_video, this field is required. A maximum of 9 Media items are supported.
> The Media struct contains: Type, the media type, String, valid values are `image`/`video`/`audio`. URL, the media download URL, String.
>
parameters.description_zh:
任务输入，Json String，包含：
- Prompt，String，必填，提示词
- Medias，媒体列表
  - 当JobType=image_to_video 时，必填，Media仅需要1个
  - 当JobType=first_last_frame 时，必填，Media仅需要2个
  - 当JobType=reference_to_video 时，必填，Media最多9个
> Media 结构包含：Type，媒体类型，String，可选值有`image`/`video`/`audio`；URL，媒体下载地址，String；
>
parameters.example: {"Prompt":"图1在篮球场上，用图2来了个灌篮","Medias":[{"Type":"image","Url":"https://xxx/xxx.jpg"},{"Type":"image","Url":"https://xxx/xxx.jpg"}]}
